## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo fmt --all`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --workspace` pass
- [ ] Tests for the change (and a `tests/engines` program if both engines are involved)
- [ ] Messages in English and Arabic
- [ ] Documented in both specifications and on the website in both languages, if users see it
- [ ] A line in `CHANGELOG.md` under `[Unreleased]`
